headline: Rio de Janeiro Office Vacancy Rate Drops to Lowest Level Since 2014
summary: The vacancy rate for prime corporate offices in Rio de Janeiro fell to 24% in the third quarter of 2016, reaching its lowest level since 2014 according to Binswanger.
why: Commercial real estate vacancy rates serve as a lagging indicator for corporate expansion, business confidence, and commercial property valuations in metropolitan markets.

impacts.name: Brazilian Commercial Real Estate
impacts.why: Falling vacancy rates indicate strengthening demand for prime corporate office space.
